forecasts.reason: E041's analogue cut about 3% (0.165 s) and lost about 0.2 pp. Early steps are steps on layers that are still learning, so this should trade near the dial rate. Expect about −0.13 s for about −0.15 pp, which the seeds 0–2 gate probably fails.

Removing Newton–Schulz saves about 0.15–0.2 s. But the freeze and LR schedules were tuned under Muon's fixed-norm filters, and SGD without renormalization interacts badly with the stem and group-2 anneals. I expect a loss of about 0.3 pp or more, though PR #3 leaves real two-sided risk.

ReLU's saving came from storing a mask instead of fp16 activations (bytes). tanh-GELU and SiLU keep the bytes and the erf cost is small, so the projected saving is likely under 1.5% and the gate closes the branch. If it does run, the time change sits within build noise.

About 32 fewer early steps saves the per-step fixed costs at low resolution (NS, optimizer, Lookahead), roughly 2%. Accuracy rides on step count (E041, E045), so expect about −0.2 pp, which supports H5.2.1.

cruxes: How large is the build-to-build variation in time, compared with accuracy? E046 read 5.08 s and then 5.19 s on the same code, while accuracy barely moved across builds. If a 1 SD time spread of about 1–2% is a property of each build, every time lever under about 2% needs CUDA-event timing, and the score is partly a lottery over builds.
Why did ReLU save 4.7%: mask bytes or erf compute? This decides whether any smooth activation can recover the saving (I097) or whether only a mask-saving activation with a top-up can.
Is Muon's advantage on CIFAR-100 real once batch size and RNG are controlled (I096)? If SGD comes within 0.2 pp, dropping Newton–Schulz is the largest identical-pipeline time lever left.
structured_output.world_model: W5 after E059. Steps on layers that are still learning carry accuracy, and early pixels do not. Freezes beat their FLOP share because they also skip BN/GELU backward and optimizer work. Build-level time noise of about ±1–2% is correlated across the 3 trials and is underpriced; the build component of accuracy is small. The seeds 0–2 ≥0.753 gate binds at a population mean of about 0.7535. The remaining wins are fixed-per-step costs (NS, Lookahead), activation bytes (a mask-saving activation plus a top-up), and fewer compiled variants to cut build variance. Early-step cuts and larger early batches trade at about the dial rate.
